* Espresso Macchiato: I left this one standing. The milk tasted sour and seemed to have been heated several times.

* Water and cola from the glass bottle: Are there no more glasses served? It seemed as if they should be drunk directly from the bottle.
* Mix-Grill: Die Cevapcici waren innen noch nicht durchgegart und es waren eedliche drei kleine Stücke. In addition, I had to express myself, no lamb meat to serve - but it was still on the teller. Das Essen haben wir daher stehen lassen.
* Goulash: Dieser wirkte leider nicht frisch. Auch dieses Gericht haben wir stehen lassen.
* Brot: Das Brot hatte nicht den Eindruck, vom selben Tag zu sein.

Das finde ich wirklich schade, weil ich euer Restaurant sehr schätze und bisher immer gerne bei euch gegessen habe.

Beim nächsten Besuch werde ich mich persönlich vorstellen. Ich werde dann dieselben Gerichte noch einmal bestellen und hoffe sehr, dass ihr mir zeigt, welche Qualität ich von euch gewohnt bin. Ich würde mich freuen, wenn mein heutiges Feedback als constructive Kritik verstanden wird, denn ich möchte auch in Zukunft gerne bei euch essen.

Përshëndetje ekipi i Kalajas,

Meqenëse restoranti juaj është një nga të preferuarit e mi, e ndiej të rëndësishme t’ju jap një feedback të sinqertë. Do të doja që të vazhdoni t’i kushtoni rëndësi cilësisë, freskisë dhe shërbimit në kuzhinë dhe në restorant.

Për vizitën time të sotme (në drekë):

* Espresso Macchiato: E lashë pa e pirë, sepse qumështi kishte shije të thartë dhe dukej sikur ishte ngrohur disa herë.
* Uji dhe Coca-Cola në shishe qelqi: A nuk shërbehen më gotat? Dukej sikur duhej të pinim direkt nga shishja.

* Gullashi: Dukej sikur nuk ishte i freskët. Edhe këtë pjatë e lamë.
* Buka: Nuk dukej e freskët, sikur nuk ishte e ditës.

Më vjen shumë keq ta them këtë, sepse gjithmonë kam pasur një mendim shumë të mirë për restorantin tuaj.

Shpresoj që këtë feedback ta merrni si kritikë konstruktive, sepse dëshira ime është të vazhdoj të jem klient i kënaqur i restorantit tuaj.

Hallo Team Kalaja,

da euer Restaurant zu meinen absoluten Favoriten gehört, ist es mir wichtig, euch ehrliches Feedback zu geben. Ich wünsche mir, dass ihr weiterhin großen Wert auf Qualität und Frische in Küche und Service legt.

* Brot: Das Brot hatte nicht den Eindruck, vom selben Tag zu sein.

Das finde ich wirklich schade, weil ich euer Restaurant sehr schätze und bisher immer gerne bei euch gegessen habe.

Beim nächsten Besuch werde ich mich persönlich vorstellen. Ich werde dann dieselben Gerichte noch einmal bestellen und hoffe sehr, dass ihr mir zeigt, welche Qualität ich von euch gewohnt bin. placeAddress: That Pink Café (ehemals Geschwister Nothaft), Schwarzastraße 9, 12055 Berlin-Bezirk Neukölln, Germany
text:
That terrible "no-cash" trend spreading across Berlin applies here, too.
It’s self-service, right down to clearing your own table, with staff who are unfriendly and barely speak, yet the tipping prompt starts at 10% (with "no tip" tucked away at the bottom, barely visible).
The food and drinks are certainly decent, solidly average but overpriced for Neukölln.
Consequently, the place mostly attracts tourists and expats who hang out amidst the décor - a wild, haphazard mix of styles - and likely think this represents "cool" Berlin.
As a local, I can only say: uncool.

Postscript: I either need to get new glasses or new translation software, because I apparently misread or misinterpreted the written English sign on the counter saying "no cash payments."
There was also no indication that I could give the "unfriendly" staff a heads-up beforehand for cash payment, which, frankly, is a bit of an outrage.
And perhaps you should take a closer look at the payment interface: the 10%, 15%, and 20% tip buttons are large and bold, whereas the "No Tip" option is tiny and greyed out at the bottom of the screen.
ownerResponseText:
Hi Michel, thank you so much for your feedback. We really appreciate our guests' feedback, and you can always pay in cash. Just let our team know before you order. Since the vast majority of our customers now prefer card payments, this has become our standard procedure. Tipping is not mandatory. The button on the screen is large and clearly designed so that every guest can decide freely and easily. Our café has 12 different employees working in shifts. A friendly atmosphere is very important to us, and we usually receive very positive feedback about our team. Of course, we all work under pressure, and on busy days, the atmosphere can sometimes be a bit tense. We will therefore take your comment into consideration internally. Our café has been around for 16 years. We make almost all of our products ourselves, using high-quality organic ingredients. We therefore believe that our prices are fair and reasonable. We would be delighted to welcome you back soon and completely win you over on your next visit!

Warm regards, Your Team at "That Pink Cafe"
ownerResponseOriginalText:
Hallo Michel, vielen Dank für dein Feedback. Wir schätzen die Rückmeldungen unserer Gäste sehr, bei uns kannst du jederzeit auch bar bezahlen. Sag unserem Team vor der Bestellung einfach kurz Bescheid. Da mittlerweile die große Mehrheit unserer Kunden die Kartenzahlung bevorzugt, ist dies unser Standardprozess geworden. Niemand ist bei uns verpflichtet, Trinkgeld zu geben. Der Button auf dem Display ist groß und transparent gestaltet, damit jeder Gast frei und unkompliziert selbst entscheiden. In unserem Café arbeiten 12 verschiedene Mitarbeiter im Wechsel. Uns liegt ein freundlicher Umgang sehr am Herzen, und wir bekommen meistens sehr liebes Feedback für unser Team. Natürlich arbeiten wir alle unter Hochdruck, und an stressigen Tagen kann die Stimmung mal etwas angespannter sein. Wir nehmen deinen Hinweis daher intern mit auf. Unser Cafe existiert schon seit 16 Jahren. Fast alle unsere Produkte stellen wir selbst her und nutzen dafür hochwertige Bio-Zutaten. Wir finden daher, dass unsere Preise fair und angemessen kalkuliert sind. Wir würden uns freuen, dich bald wieder bei uns zu begrüßen und dich bei deinem nächsten Besuch komplett zu überzeugen!
 Herzliche Grüße 
Dein Team von "That Pink Cafe"

text:
★★★★★

Vegan, queer-friendly, and simply a place to feel good. 🫶 The language and design are inclusive, even the restrooms, and I love this naturalness and the statement made by the Bikinikill T-shirt behind the counter.

I've been coming here since 2012 and I truly love all the cakes and pastries. With matcha or coffee, sometimes that's all I need. They also offer savory treats. And absolutely EVERYTHING is homemade. 🥹

Especially in a time when it feels like everything is constantly changing, this place has become a little piece of stability and home for me. A place I always love coming back to. 💚

★★★★★

Gerade in einer Zeit, in der sich gefühlt ständig alles verändert, ist dieser Ort für mich ein kleines Stück Beständigkeit und Zuhause geworden. Ein Ort, an den ich immer wieder gerne zurückkomme. 💚

placeAddress: Sukanya Thai Imbiss, Richardstraße 4, 12043 Berlin-Bezirk Neukölln, Germany
text:
At first glance, the place seems genuinely authentic: small, simple, and with Thai staff behind the stove – it definitely makes a good impression and raises expectations.

Unfortunately, the problems start with the price list. There's no clear, reliable menu. Instead, various notes, pictures, and cards with crossed-out prices and handwritten changes are posted everywhere. On the actual menu, some prices have been completely removed. This is far from transparent.

The biggest shock came when it was time to pay: charging almost €30 for two appetizers and a main course is quite steep for a snack bar – especially without clear pricing beforehand.

The food itself tasted okay, but by no means outstanding enough to justify the price. The portions were disappointing: the "crispy chicken" consisted of only four small pieces – far from what one would normally expect.

The worst part, however, was the packaging. Everything was poorly and partially openly wrapped. The papaya salad leaked completely, as did the soup – and all this after only about ten minutes of transport. In the end, I had a soggy bag and a leaked soup that I could barely eat. This is simply unacceptable.

Conclusion: The taste was okay, but the price-performance ratio and especially the packaging are absolutely unacceptable. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this product.
originalText:
Der Laden wirkt auf den ersten Blick wirklich authentisch: klein, schlicht und mit thailändischem Personal hinterm Herd – das macht definitiv einen guten Eindruck und weckt Erwartungen.

Leider fangen die Probleme schon bei der Preisübersicht an. Es gibt keine klare, verlässliche Karte. Stattdessen hängen überall verschiedene Zettel, Bilder und Karten mit durchgestrichenen Preisen und handschriftlichen Änderungen. Auf der eigentlichen Speisekarte sind die Preise teilweise komplett entfernt. Transparenz sieht anders aus.

Der größte Schock kam dann beim Bezahlen: Für zwei Vorspeisen und einen Hauptgang knapp 30 € zu verlangen, ist für einen Imbiss schon sehr happig – vor allem ohne vorher klare Preisangaben.

Das Essen selbst war geschmacklich in Ordnung, aber keinesfalls herausragend genug, um den Preis zu rechtfertigen. Die Portionen waren enttäuschend: Beim „Hähnchen kross“ gab es lediglich vier kleine Stücke – das ist weit entfernt von dem, was man sonst erwartet.

Am schlimmsten war jedoch die Verpackung. Alles war schlecht und teilweise offen verpackt. Der Papaya-Salat ist komplett ausgelaufen, genauso wie die Suppe – und das bei nur etwa zehn Minuten Transport. Am Ende hatte ich eine durchweichte Tüte und eine ausgelaufene Suppe, die ich kaum noch genießen konnte. So etwas geht einfach gar nicht.

Fazit: Geschmack okay, aber Preis-Leistung und vor allem die Verpackung sind absolut inakzeptabel. Leider keine Empfehlung.

text:
It's something different.

We hadn't tried Korean BBQ before and seized the opportunity.

Admittedly, it's a bit like regular grilling, just with different ingredients, but it still tastes great, and the experience is definitely different.

Service is a top priority at Ssam; the staff is friendly, courteous, and extremely attentive. For example, I accidentally dropped one of my chopsticks, almost without noticing. Ten seconds later, a new set arrived at my table without me even asking—outstanding!

I can't say for sure about the price, as I don't have any reference points. It was definitely cheaper than the hot pot I had in Hamburg (and better, too, but that's not because of the Hamburg restaurant; I'm just not a big fan of the hot pot concept).

But I would say the price is reasonable considering the quality.

All in all, highly recommended!
originalText:
Ist mal was anderes.

Wir hatten bisher noch kein Korean BBQ ausprobiert und haben nun die Chance ergriffen.

Zugegeben, es ist ein wenig wie normales Grillen, nur mit anderen Zutaten, aber schmecken tut es natürlich trotzdem und die Erfahrung ist halt doch eine etwas andere.

Service wird bei Ssam groß geschrieben, das Personal ist nett, zuvorkommend und überaus aufmerksam. Als Beispiel: Mit ist versehentlich, kaum merkbar, eines meiner Stäbchen heruntergefallen. 10 Sekunden später hatte ich unaufgefordert einen neuen Satz am Platz - herausragend!

Preislich kann ich es nicht zu 100% einordnen, da mir Referenzwerte fehlen. War auf jeden Fall günstiger als der HotPot den ich in Hamburg hatte (und auch besser, aber das liegt nicht am Restaurant in Hamburg, ich werd mit dem HotPot konzept nicht wirklich warm).
Ich würde aber sagen der Preis ist angemessen in Relation zur Liestung.

Alles in allem Empfehlenswert!

text:
I held my 40th birthday here last weekend. If I could give it 10 stars I would.

Drinks were exceptional and they converted me to natural wine which I didn’t think possible!! The quality of their choices - all the way up to their champagne and cocktails was exceptional.

We also had beautiful canapés - oysters, shallot tarte tatin, mushroom croquettes, halibut and chicory, duck belinis…and my guests couldn’t stop talking about the food.

But even though the food and drinks were high quality - our experience was relaxed, happy, easy, and the most fun. The team was brilliant and kind from start to finish and I was allowed to make the event what I wanted it to be.

And Richardkiez in Neukölln is such a beautiful little corner of Berlin.

I would recommend it wholeheartedly and will be back regularly for a glass of wine or 10!

text:
Edit review after being there 10 times:

If you are looking for an exceptional dining experience in Berlin, **Spindler** is a must-visit destination. Perfectly situated along the scenic banks of the Landwehrkanal on Paul-Lincke-Ufer in Kreuzberg, this elegant canal-side brasserie masterfully bridges the gap between casual Berlin coolness and refined gastronomy.
Housed in a meticulously restored historic building that is over a century old, the interior immediately captivates you with its warm, stylish ambiance. Designed with custom walnut wood tables, exposed whitewashed brick walls, and intimate lighting, it creates an atmosphere that is both incredibly cozy and undeniably chic. During the warmer months, their beautiful waterfront patio is the ultimate spot to relax and watch the vibrant Kreuzberg life go by.
The menu at Spindler focuses on modern, seasonally-driven French and international cuisine prepared with absolute passion. Whether you are stopping by for their legendary weekend brunch—complete with perfectly executed Eggs Benedict—or a relaxed multi-course dinner featuring flawlessly cooked regional meats and fresh market vegetables, the quality remains consistently outstanding.
Pair your meal with a choice selection from their fantastic wine list or a expertly crafted cocktail from the proper, full-service bar. Combined with incredibly attentive and friendly service, Spindler delivers an unforgettable, top-tier Berlin dining experience.

text:
I rarely write reviews, but in this case, I really felt compelled to. Unfortunately, in my opinion, this place is vastly overrated.

We came to the restaurant to celebrate a birthday with a nice brunch. Sadly, it turned out to be neither a particularly pleasant nor a festive occasion. The prices are far too high for the portion sizes. The food was also nothing special: the Croque Madame was rather dry and quite bland, and the two Eggs Benedict looked almost like a single serving.

The glass in which the cocktail was served had a crack. After a new cocktail was brought, it seemed as if the drink had simply been poured into a different, smaller glass instead of actually being prepared from scratch.

One napkin per person is apparently some kind of Berlin standard. The coffee was bitter. Unfortunately, no water was offered. We did order dessert at the end, but there was no special presentation, even though we had indicated in our reservation that we were celebrating a birthday. Overall, the service was average and not particularly friendly.

The only positive aspects were the smile of the woman handling the payment and the attractive clientele, who are what really make this place special.

Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this restaurant for a special occasion.

Ich schreibe selten Bewertungen, aber in diesem Fall hatte ich wirklich das Bedürfnis, eine zu schreiben. Leider ist der Ort meiner Meinung nach sehr überbewertet.

Wir sind in das Restaurant gekommen, um einen Geburtstag mit einem schönen Brunch zu feiern. Leider wurde daraus weder ein besonders schöner noch ein festlicher Moment. Die Preise sind im Verhältnis zur Portionsgröße deutlich zu hoch. Geschmacklich war es ebenfalls nichts Besonderes: Der Croque Madame war etwas trocken und geschmacklich eher unspektakulär, und die zwei Eggs Benedict sahen fast wie eine einzige Portion aus.

Das Glas, in dem der Cocktail serviert wurde, hatte einen Riss. Nachdem ein neuer Cocktail gebracht wurde, entstand der Eindruck, dass der Drink einfach in ein anderes, kleineres Glas umgefüllt wurde, anstatt ihn wirklich neu zuzubereiten.

Eine Serviette pro Person ist wahrscheinlich irgendeine Berliner Norm. Der Kaffee war bitter. Leider wurde dazu kein Wasser angeboten. Zum Schluss hatten wir zwar noch ein Dessert bestellt, aber es gab keinerlei besondere Präsentation, obwohl bei der Reservierung angegeben war, dass wir einen Geburtstag feiern. Der Service war insgesamt durchschnittlich und nicht besonders freundlich.

Der einzige Pluspunkt war das Lächeln der Frau, die abkassiert hat, sowie die schönen Gäste, die eigentlich die Atmosphäre dieses Ortes ausmachen.

Leider kann ich dieses Lokal für einen besonderen Anlass nicht empfehlen.

text:
For the first time in my life, I tried snails and tartar here, at the insistence of my friends. It's not my style to eat things like that; they loved the snails, while I just wanted to devour them quickly. It was bad for me, a first and last time. The tartar was raw meat, so that was also a first and last time for me.

As for my recommendations, the red meat cooked in red wine was wonderfully shredded. That was number one. The ribeye steak was Argentinian, but when ordered well-done, it wasn't that great. The portions were quite small for the price, by the way. There was also dry-aged meat, which was better than the ribeye, but again, the portion was quite small. If I were to go there again, I would try the meat cooked in red wine.

The atmosphere is decent, a classic place, neither amazing nor terrible.

The San Sebastian cheesecake wasn't bad; how bad could it be anyway?

text:
Restaurant Spindler definitely scores points with its superb location and lovely outdoor seating; it's truly cozy. The food itself was also excellent: the selection of French dishes, from appetizers to desserts, was well-chosen, and everything tasted delicious. However, the portions were quite small for the prices.

The downside for us was the timing. As a family with two teenagers, we ended up spending over three hours in the restaurant for three courses. That felt rather drawn out. The service seemed quite distant and, as the restaurant became busier, noticeably overwhelmed.

Anyone with time to spare and who doesn't mind long waits will certainly enjoy the good food and the ambiance. For us, though, the evening was just a bit too slow in the end.
originalText:
Das Restaurant Spindler punktet auf jeden Fall mit seiner super Lage und den tollen Außenplätzen, man sitzt dort wirklich gemütlich. Auch das Essen selbst war top: Die Auswahl an französischen Gerichten von der Vor- bis zur Nachspeise passt, und geschmacklich war alles lecker. Allerdings sind die Portionen für die aufgerufenen Preise schon sehr überschaubar.

Der Haken an der Sache war für uns das Timing. Für drei Gänge haben wir als Familie mit zwei Jugendlichen am Ende über drei Stunden im Restaurant verbracht. Das hat sich dann doch arg in die Länge gezogen. Der Service wirkte dazu recht distanziert und war mit der Zeit, als es voller wurde, auch spürbar überfordert.

placeAddress: Spindler, Paul-Lincke-Ufer 42/43, 10999 Berlin-Bezirk Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg, Germany
placeDescription: Cocktails, brunch & French-inspired, seasonal dinner offered in a stylish spot with a terrace.
text:
For me, still one of Berlin's best brunch spots. Located right on the Paul-Lincke-Ufer, it boasts a beautiful, classic bistro atmosphere, excellent coffee, and a menu that's significantly more ambitious than many hyped "Instagram brunch joints."

I'm particularly impressed by the quality of the ingredients and the care taken in the kitchen. This time, I had the "Something English": homemade cheddar-jalapeño sausages, white pudding, really good bacon, superbly seasoned portobello mushrooms, homemade baked beans, and perfectly cooked eggs. Very robust, very well-rounded, and perfectly balanced.

The Eggs Benedict were also outstanding: crispy bacon, good hollandaise, and high-quality ingredients. And the coffee was truly excellent—at least on par with "House of Small Wonder," but with an even wider selection.

The "Burnt Basque Cheesecake" was tasty, pleasantly caramelized, and beautifully creamy, though not quite as groundbreaking as its reputation suggests.

The homemade lemonades are also very good, though at eight euros they're a bit pricey.

Overall, it's a place where you can easily sit for several hours. Very stylish, but not uncomfortably pretentious. The location by the canal makes it almost dangerously cozy in the summer.
originalText:
Für mich weiterhin einer der besten Brunch-Spots Berlins. Direkt am Paul-Lincke-Ufer gelegen, wunderschönes klassisches Bistro-Ambiente, hervorragender Kaffee und eine Karte, die deutlich ambitionierter ist als bei vielen gehypten „Instagram-Brunchläden“.

Besonders stark finde ich die Qualität der Produkte und die Sorgfalt in der Küche. Ich hatte diesmal das „Something English“: selbstgemachte Cheddar-Jalapeño-Würstchen, White Pudding, richtig guten Bacon, hervorragend gewürzten Portobello-Pilz, hausgemachte Baked Beans und perfekt gebratene Eier. Sehr kräftig, sehr rund, sehr gut abgestimmt.
Auch die Eggs Benedict waren hervorragend: knuspriger Bacon, gute Hollandaise, hochwertige Zutaten. Dazu wirklich exzellenter Kaffee – mindestens auf dem Niveau vom „House of Small Wonder“, nur mit noch größerer Auswahl.

Der „Burnt Basque Cheesecake“ war lecker, angenehm karamellig und schön cremig, wenn auch für mich nicht ganz so weltbewegend wie sein Ruf.

Die hausgemachten Limonaden sind ebenfalls sehr gut, preislich mit acht Euro allerdings schon sportlich.

Insgesamt ein Ort, an dem man problemlos mehrere Stunden sitzen kann. Sehr stilvoll, aber nicht unangenehm geschniegelt. Gerade die Lage am Kanal macht das Ganze im Sommer fast schon gefährlich gemütlich.

text:
For the price, you really can't complain. Fresh pizza bread with the salad (and they even brought another basket afterwards), which unfortunately isn't often the case, even at much more upscale Italian restaurants! What's also great is that it's an Italian restaurant with Italian staff! Admittedly, the ambiance isn't amazing. Very basic, but the staff is incredibly friendly. I was looking forward to the Lambrusco.

They're currently not serving alcohol, which is something I've never experienced before. Nevertheless, if you want a reasonably priced and pleasant meal and don't care too much about the atmosphere, this is the place for you. I would go there again as a tourist.

Además, los precios son inigualables para la calidad y cantidad que ofrecen, y las bebidas también están deliciosas.

Vale muchísimo la pena ir; es de esos lugares que uno quiere guardar como secreto. Pilas: solo reciben efectivo, así que vayan preparados. Sin duda, un lugar al que volvería una y otra vez. Súper recomendado!

I never particularly liked the place anyway, and I only went there for my sister's sake, because she wanted to go for her birthday.

After a 40-minute drive, I had to wait 22 minutes before a table even became available. When a customer finally got up, the employee simply gave the table to two other guests, even though I had been waiting the whole time. His explanation was that they were "all there" and I was still waiting for my sister.

I explained that I wanted to order right away and that my sister and the others were just looking for a parking spot. They arrived less than three minutes later. Despite this, all I got was the response: "Tough luck, those are the rules."

I would have understood if I had been holding a table for a longer period. But I wanted to order immediately, and my companion was practically already there. To simply give the table to other guests after waiting for over 20 minutes is, in my opinion, incredibly unfriendly.

That was my last visit. Such service is simply disappointing.

Ich mochte den Laden ohnehin nie besonders und bin nur meiner Schwester zuliebe hingefahren, weil sie sich das zu ihrem Geburtstag gewünscht hat.

Nach einer 40-minütigen Anfahrt musste ich zunächst 22 Minuten warten, bis überhaupt ein Tisch frei wurde. Als endlich eine Kundin aufstand, vergab der Mitarbeiter den Platz einfach an zwei andere Gäste, obwohl ich bereits die ganze Zeit gewartet hatte. Seine Begründung war, dass diese „vollzählig“ gewesen seien und ich noch auf meine Schwester gewartet hätte.

Ich habe ihm erklärt, dass ich bereits bestellen wollte und meine Schwester und die anderen nur noch einen Parkplatz suchten. Sie waren keine drei Minuten später da. Trotzdem bekam ich nur die Antwort: „Pech, das sind die Regeln.“

Ich hätte Verständnis gehabt, wenn ich einen Tisch über längere Zeit blockiert hätte. Aber ich wollte sofort bestellen und meine Begleitung war praktisch schon da. Nach über 20 Minuten Wartezeit den Tisch dann einfach an andere Gäste zu vergeben, finde ich absolut kundenunfreundlich.

text:
Finally, a truly awful rest stop in Neukölln!

Before an event at Heimathafen, we grabbed a quick burger here. The place was empty and reeked of old grease as soon as we walked in.

Unfortunately, the burgers were truly terrible. The bread was soft and soggy, the two patties charred beyond recognition and dried out. They were topped with some cheese, a few leaves of iceberg lettuce, and a pickle. Even if it was supposed to be Angus beef (you could see the patties shrink by about 50-60% while grilling), it was completely ruined. The taste was just burnt and dry. The price-performance ratio is unacceptable.

I've rarely been so disappointed. I definitely won't be back and can only advise against eating a burger here.

It's also striking that many of the positive Google reviews are several years old and show products that apparently no longer exist. In my opinion, the current average rating doesn't reflect the quality at all.
originalText:
Endlich untere Raststättenqualitat in Neukölln

Vor einem Event im Heimathafen haben wir hier kurzfristig einen Burger gegessen. Der Laden war leer und roch bereits beim Betreten stark nach altem Fett.

Die Burger waren leider wirklich schlecht. Das Brot weich und labbrig, die zwei Patties bis zur Unkenntlichkeit verkohlt und ausgetrocknet. Darüber etwas Käse, ein paar Blätter Eisbergsalat und Essiggurke. Selbst wenn es sich um Angusfleisch gehandelt haben sollte (man konnte beobachten, wie die Patties beim Grillen etwa 50–60 % ihrer Größe verloren), wurde es am Grill komplett verhunzt. Geschmacklich nur verbrannt und trocken. Das Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis ist entsprechend nicht akzeptabel.

Ich bin selten so enttäuscht gewesen. Ich komme definitiv nicht wieder und kann nur davon abraten, hier einen Burger zu essen.

Auffällig ist zudem, dass viele der positiven Google-Bewertungen mehrere Jahre alt sind und Produkte zeigen, die es in dieser Form offenbar nicht mehr gibt. Die aktuelle Durchschnittsbewertung spiegelt die heutige Qualität aus meiner Sicht überhaupt nicht wider.

MASTAN, Gneisenaustraße 67, 10961 Berlin, Germany
text:
We had a rough travel day getting to Berlin, but MASTAN was very accommodating and graciously let us move our 6:30 PM reservation to 9:30 PM.

The highlight of the night was definitely the service. Our server was fantastic super knowledgeable about wines and very attentive despite us being one of the last tables.

Sadly, the food didn't live up to the service or the price point. The bread was stale, the cold cuts dry, and the steak was so aggressively salted that it overwhelmed my palate and ruined the taste of my wine.

When we brought it up, the staff handled it with total grace apologising genuinely and offering to re-cook the steak for us. While I wouldn't come back for the food, I’d certainly stop by again for the atmosphere, the wine, and the lovely team.

placeAddress: MASTAN, Gneisenaustraße 67, 10961 Berlin, Germany
MASTAN, Gneisenaustraße 67, 10961 Berlin, Germany
text:
We came to Mastan Berlin with high expectations and left very disappointed. While the service was acceptable and the outdoor seating is pleasant, the food quality was far below standard—especially for the price.
The baguette was clearly not fresh, the tomatoes were served warm, and the €46 steak was extremely salty to the point of being inedible. The cold cuts also did not taste fresh. Despite this, we still paid a €180 bill, which felt completely unjustified.
The only highlight was the wine, which was effectively upsold by the waiter and enjoyable. However, this does not make up for the poor food quality. Berlin offers far better dining experiences at a fraction of the cost. I would not recommend this restaurant for food—at best, it is a place to have a glass of wine outside.

placeAddress: MASTAN, Gneisenaustraße 67, 10961 Berlin, Germany
MASTAN, Gneisenaustraße 67, 10961 Berlin, Germany
text:
We had seats on the terrace, which was more of a spot in front of the restaurant on the street. Since the street was closed to traffic, the noise level was pleasant.

The seating consisted of very simple wooden folding chairs, the kind you see in old-fashioned restaurants, and the round table was a bit small.

We received a very friendly welcome.

We chose the 300g entrecote steak with fries, as the other four main courses didn't appeal to us.

The fries were homemade and nice and crispy, and the peppercorn sauce we chose was also tasty. I expected more from the steak, especially considering the price of €46. It lacked finesse, and we would have appreciated a more elegant presentation.

The steak sat alone on the plate and, without any garnish, looked rather unappealing, although it was cooked to the desired doneness. However, it lacked the rich, meaty flavor one expects from high-quality meat.

The staff emphasized that the meat was supposed to be of high quality. We didn't feel that way.

The service was very attentive and friendly.

Unfortunately, the food wasn't good enough to make us want to come back.
originalText:
Wir hatten Plätze auf der Terrasse, wobei es sich eher um einen Platz vor dem Restaurant auf der Straße handelt. Da die Straße für den Verkehr gesperrt war, war es von angenehmer Lautstärke.

Die Sitzgelegenheiten waren sehr einfache Holzklappstühle, wie man sie von früher kennt,  der rundeTisch war etwas klein.

Wir wurden sehr freundlich empfangen.

Als Gericht wählten wir das Entrecote Steak 300 g mit Pommes, da uns die anderen 4 Hauptgerichte nicht überzeugten.

Die Pommes waren selbstgemacht und schön kross, die gewählte Pfeffersosse schmeckte auch gut. Vom Steak hätte ich mir mehr erwartet bei einem Preis von 46 Euro. Uns fehlte die Finesse, auch eine liebevollere Anrichtung hätten wir uns gewünscht.

Das Steak lag allein auf dem Teller, und sah ohne Garnitur eher lieblos aus,  es hatte aber die gewünschte Garstufe. Uns fehlte jedoch der gute Fleischgeschmack, wie man ihn von hochwertigen Produkten kennt.

Das es sich um hochwertiges Fleisch handeln sollte wurde vom Personal hervorgehoben. Wir empfanden es nicht so.

Die Bedienung war sehr aufmerksam und freundlich.

Leider war das Essen nicht so,  dass es uns zum Wiederkommen bewegen würde.

placeAddress: MASTAN, Gneisenaustraße 67, 10961 Berlin, Germany
text:
Mastan might just be the most Parisian restaurant in Berlin. It's the kind of place that makes you want to slow down, order another glass, and stay until they start stacking chairs. Solo dining at the bar turned out to be the perfect way to experience it.

I started with saucisson, olives and bread alongside a glass of Saint Cosme Côtes-du-Rhône 2023, and it was one of those moments where simplicity becomes a statement. Peppery, flavourful sausage, a proper baguette, briny bitter olives and a wine that tied it all together - quality ingredients doing what quality ingredients do. It's the kind of opener that reminds you how far great produce takes you.

The main was the same philosophy applied to steak with béarnaise, side salad and crispy potatoes. Sounds straightforward, and it is but the execution was flawless. The meat was juicy and deeply flavourful, and even the fat trim, which I usually leave on the plate, was genuinely DELICIOUS. The béarnaise had exactly the right acidity and tarragon balance. The potatoes were crisp and properly salted. Eight out of ten restaurants serve some version of this dish. Very few nail it like this.

I finished with a Jurançon - less sweet and more elegant than your typical dessert wine - followed by a double espresso and a small calvados. Unhurried, indulgent, exactly right.

The service has a distinct French quality to it, staff switching between French among themselves and accented English with guests. It adds to the atmosphere rather than detracting from it and the attention was warm without being intrusive. The room itself is intimate and genuinely romantic - there are outdoor tables that looked equally charming - but the bar works brilliantly for solo dining too.

If I lived in Berlin, I'd be a regular. Since I don't, I'll be back the next time I'm in town regardless. For anyone who appreciates classical French cooking done without shortcuts, Mastan earns every visit.
Compliments to the management, the service staff and the chefs.

text:

However, as it got increasingly crowded, no one came to our table. I would have liked to order more wine, but no one came for so long that we decided to leave. The tables are quite close together, so you can overhear conversations at the next table, but if everyone is mindful of their noise level, it's fine.

We will definitely come back because the atmosphere and the food were excellent. We hope the service will be a bit more attentive next time :)

text:

Today, in 30-degree heat, I got vanilla. For that price, you expect quality, but what I got was a bad joke. The ice cream was completely watery, not creamy at all, and didn't taste like vanilla at all – just sweet ice cream.

text: Yes, I'm a bit conflicted. Why? Take the Saltimbocca, for example: pork 🐷 for €25, while a normal (real) Italian restaurant charges only between €24 and €27.50 for veal (the authentic kind). Something's not right here! What else did we have today? Pollo Insalata €16 = Grade 3, Scaloppa Milanese, visually appealing, meat and vegetables a bit more than lukewarm, potatoes piping hot = Grade 3, Grodino and Aperol Spritz = good. Panna Cotta had a good consistency = Grade 2.5. And finally... would you like a complimentary drink? Since I'm driving, I asked for an espresso... then the discussion... too expensive, the owner Luigi forbade it... but no matter what kind of liquor... cost is no object... incomprehensible. So, a better Italian restaurant for Neukölln, but not for Lichterfelde or Köpenick. Would I come back? What's also very strange is that there's no seafood. The waiter's answer: too expensive and they go stale quickly... What a joke!
originalText: Ja, ich bin ein wenig zwiespältig. Warum? Nehmen wir Saltimbocca hier Schweinefleisch 🐷 und 25 Euro, ein normaler Italiener (echter) verlangt mit Kalbfleisch (die echte Art) gerade mal zwischen 24 - 27,50 Euro. Hier passt was nicht! Heute hatten wir noch? Pollo Insalata 16 Euro=Note 3, Scaloppa Milanese, schön für das Auge, Fleisch und Gemüse etwas mehr als lau warm, Kartoffeln heiss = Note 3, Grodino und Aperol Spritz= gut. Panna Cotta hatte ein gute Konsistenz= Note 2,5. Und zum Schluss... möchten sie ein Getränk auf KOSTEN des Hauses? Da ich fahre, hat ich um einen Espresso.... dann die Diskussion....zu teuer, hat der Chef Luigi untersagt... aber egal welchen Schnaps...da spielen die Kosten keine Rolle...muss man nicht verstehen. Also für Neukölln ein besserer Italiener, aber nicht für Lichterfelde oder Köpenick. Wieder kommen??? Was auch sehr eigenartig ist, es gibt keine Frutti di Mare. Antwort Kellner, zu teuer und werden schnell alt....Was für ein Unding...

text:
The sausages and meat products are quite good.

Unfortunately, the small saleswoman with glasses and dark hair is always so incredibly unfriendly and seems annoyed as soon as a customer enters the shop. You're neither greeted nor do you hear a "please" or "thank you." I think she should find a job without customer contact if she doesn't enjoy serving people. You immediately feel unwelcome. I find this very disappointing because I've been a regular customer for almost 10 years, but when she serves you, you always leave with a bad feeling.

The other employees are friendly by Berlin standards.

Luckily, there are other traditional butchers in the area, and in my opinion, they should treat their customers with respect.

I find this kind of behavior completely incomprehensible. Everyone has a bad day now and then, but this woman is simply always annoyed and behaves with utter disrespect.

It's a shame, really. I always enjoyed going there, but when that lady is in the shop, I think twice about whether I shouldn't just drive on to another butcher shop. There are at least two others in Neukölln whose products are just as good, and in some cases even better. And you get treated like an equal there.

Man wird weder begrüßt noch hört man ein bitte oder danke. Ich glaube sie sollte sich besser einen Beruf ohne kundenkontakt suchen wenn sie keine Lust hat Menschen zu bedienen. text:
I was looking for a suckling pig for my farewell party in December 2025. During my online research, I came across the blood sausage manufactory. After visiting their butcher shop, it was clear we were in the right place. We ordered a 27kg pig, which should be enough for about 35-42 people. The delivery was very punctual, and the suckling pig was absolutely fantastic. Beautifully crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. Simply perfect, and everyone was thrilled. With about 40 people, we were all satisfied. We provided the side dishes ourselves. Returning the borrowed board and knife was also completely straightforward. I can highly recommend the blood sausage manufactory. If we have suckling pig again, it will only be from Rixdorf.

Excellent value for money!!!

Thanks again! 👍
originalText:
Ich suchte für meinen Ausstand im Dezember 2025 ein Spanferkel. Bei meinen Recherchen im Netz bin auf die Blutwurstmanufaktur gestoßen. Nach einem Besuch in der Metzgerei war klar, hier sind wir richtig. Bestellt haben wir dann ein 27kg Schweinchen, welches für ca. 35-42 Personen reichen sollte. Die Lieferung erfolgte sehr pünktlich und das Spanferkel war der absolute Hammer. Außen schön knusprig und innen saftig. Einfach perfekt und alle waren begeistert. Wir sind mit ca. 40 Leuten auch alle satt geworden. Die Beilagen hatten wir in Eigenregie gestellt. Die Rückgabe des geliehenen Brettes und des Messers war dann auch völlig unkompliziert. Ich kann die Blutwurstmanufaktur wärmstens empfehlen. Wenn wieder Spanferkel, dann nur aus Rixdorf.
Sehr gutes Preis-Leistungs-Verältnis!!!
Vielen Dank nochmal 👍

text:
The three of us went to Austria and we were all absolutely thrilled. The Wiener Schnitzel is really good and the portions are huge. Even the small schnitzel is more than generous, but you should definitely come hungry for the large one. 😄 The side dishes were also delicious.

Be sure to save room for the Kaiserschmarrn! It's made fresh to order, so you'll have to wait about 20 minutes, but it's definitely worth it.

We thoroughly enjoyed our meal there; the service was incredibly friendly and pleasantly uncomplicated. All in all, a wonderful evening and definitely 5 stars. We'll be back!

Wir waren zu dritt im Austria und wirklich alle begeistert. Das Wiener Schnitzel ist richtig gut und die Portionen sind riesig. Selbst das kleine Schnitzel ist schon mehr als ordentlich, beim großen sollte man wirklich Hunger mitbringen. 😄 Auch die Beilagen waren super lecker.

Unbedingt noch Platz für den Kaiserschmarrn lassen! Der wird frisch gemacht, deshalb wartet man ungefähr 20 Minuten, aber es lohnt sich wirklich.

Wir saßen total gerne dort, der Service war super nett und angenehm unkompliziert. Für uns ein rundum schöner Abend und definitiv 5 Sterne. Wir kommen wieder!

placeAddress: Kebab Haus, Saalestraße 41, 12055 Berlin, Germany
text:
The best kebab I've ever had! Seriously, I've been here twice and wasn't disappointed either time.

In fact, the second time I visited Berlin, I made a point of adding this place to our itinerary so I could bring my friends here—and they absolutely loved it as well.

My first visit also came with a wonderful story. I accidentally left my bag on a chair outside the restaurant, with my wallet, keys, and other personal belongings inside. I only realized it after I had walked back to my hotel a few streets away.

As I ran back, I was convinced someone had already taken it. Instead, the restaurant staff had noticed the bag, kept it safe, and returned it to me as soon as they saw me coming back.

Amazing people and a place that's clearly run with passion. Thank you again Guys!

text: After a quick Google search for a bakery or pastry shop nearby, I came across this place. The selection of cakes and baklava was fantastic. We each had a cake and a baklava. The cake was incredibly delicious and, even better, really affordable for the quality. The baklava was also delicious. The best thing about the shop, however, is the amazing cakes. They're all homemade cakes, decorated to order, and offered at a great price. The cakes start at around €35. So, the price is a real steal for such delicious and beautiful cakes. In short, if you want to eat delicious cakes, tarts, or baklava at a great price, you should definitely go there.
originalText: Nach einer kurzen Suche auf Google nach einem Bäcker oder Konditor in der Nähe auf duesen Laden gestoßen. Das Angebot an Kuchen und Backlava war echt Klasse. Wir haben jeweils Kuchen und Backlava gegessen. Der Kuch war suoer lecker und noch besser für die Qualität auch echt günstig. Das Backlava war auch echt lecker. Das Beste am Laden sind due tollen Torten. Ganzen selbst gemachte Torten nach Wunsch Dekuriert und für einem suoer Preis dann angeboten. Die Torten gehen wohl preislich ab 35 euro los. Der Preis also hier auch echt der Hammer für echt leckere und super aussehende Torten. Fazit wer günstig und lecker Kuchen, Torten oder Backlava essen möchte sollte dort hinfahren.

text: DO NOT GO HERE FOR GLUTEN FREE. This place came up for gluten free schnitzel but it's just meat with no breading. 29 euro. Not worth it
ownerResponseText:
Thank you for your feedback.

We regret that your visit did not meet your expectations. However, we would like to clarify your account: Of course, we also offer our schnitzel with gluten-free breading. This has long been part of our menu, and we take the utmost care to accommodate guests with food intolerances or celiac disease.

The fact that you were served a plain schnitzel is by no means our standard and can only be attributed to a misunderstanding or a communication error. It would have been helpful if you had addressed this directly at the restaurant; we would have rectified the mistake immediately.

Therefore, we strongly reject the blanket statement that guests with gluten-free diets should avoid our restaurant.

We place great importance on offering suitable and delicious alternatives to guests with special dietary needs.
ownerResponseOriginalText:
Vielen Dank für Ihre Rückmeldung.

Wir bedauern, dass Ihr Besuch nicht Ihren Erwartungen entsprochen hat. Allerdings möchten wir Ihre Darstellung richtigstellen: Selbstverständlich panieren wir unsere Schnitzel auch mit glutenfreier Panade. Dies gehört seit Langem zu unserem Angebot, und wir erfüllen entsprechende Gästewünsche bei Unverträglichkeiten oder Zöliakie mit größter Sorgfalt.

Dass Ihnen ein naturgebratenes Schnitzel serviert wurde, entspricht keinesfalls unserem Standard und kann nur auf einem Missverständnis oder einer fehlerhaften Kommunikation beruhen. Es wäre hilfreich gewesen, wenn Sie dies direkt vor Ort angesprochen hätten, wir hätten den Fehler umgehend korrigiert.

Die pauschale Aussage, glutenfrei essende Gäste sollten unser Restaurant meiden, weisen wir daher entschieden zurück. 
Wir legen großen Wert darauf, auch Gästen mit besonderen Ernährungsbedürfnissen eine passende und schmackhafte Alternative anzubieten.

text: The historic Bohemian Village, a surprising area of ​​Neukölln, a district normally dominated by Middle Eastern culture, is a settlement in Berlin founded by Protestants who failed to win their struggle against Catholics in the Czech Republic. A statue stands in the neighborhood as a token of gratitude to King Wilhelm I of Prussia, who welcomed them. There's also a street named for Czech theologian Jan Hun, one of the founding fathers of Protestantism, whose views are distinct from those of modern-day Neukölln. Its tranquil atmosphere makes it well worth a visit.
originalText: Normalde Orta doğu kültürünün ağır bastığı Neukölln semtinin ilk kez karşılaşıldığında şaşırtacak bir bölgesi olan tarihi Bohemyalılar Köyü, Çekya’da Katoliklere karşı verdikleri mücadeleyi kazanamayan protestanların Berlin’de kurduğu bir yerleşim yeridir. Semtte kendilerini karşılayan Prusya Kralı I. Wilhelm’e teşekkür göstergesi olarak dikilen heykel bulunmaktadır. Aynı zamanda görüşleriyle protestanlığın kurucu fikir babalarından biri olan Çek teolog Jan Hun için isimlendirilmiş bir sokak bulunmaktadır. Günümüz Neukölln’ünden farklı ve sakin yapısıyla ziyarete değerdir.

text:
This was our first time here, and we received a very warm welcome. The drinks were fantastic and a perfect start to the evening. The two of us opted for the Xberg Duck menu. The dumpling, in particular, was a clear 10/10 for us and definitely one of the highlights of the evening.

Unfortunately, the duck in the later courses was a bit dry, which was a little disappointing, as we've had better ducks before. I understand that it's a challenge to prepare the duck fresh and perfectly crispy at the same time – difficult, but certainly achievable. Preparing it fresher would make a significant difference in taste, rather than simply crisping it up again in the oven. After all, it works in Beijing. 😉

However, this is really nitpicking, because overall the food was delicious, the service attentive, and the atmosphere thoroughly pleasant. A truly great restaurant that we would visit again anytime!
originalText:
Wir waren zum ersten Mal hier und wurden direkt sehr freundlich empfangen. Die Drinks waren großartig und haben den Abend perfekt gestartet. Zu zweit haben wir uns für das Xberg-Duck-Menü entschieden. Besonders das Dumpling war für uns eine klare 10/10 und definitiv eines der Highlights des Abends.

Die Ente in den späteren Gängen war leider etwas trocken, was ein wenig schade war, da wir schon bessere Enten gegessen haben. Ich verstehe, dass es eine Herausforderung ist, die Ente frisch und gleichzeitig perfekt knusprig zuzubereiten – schwierig, aber sicherlich machbar. Eine frischere Zubereitung würde geschmacklich noch einmal einen deutlichen Unterschied machen, statt die Ente lediglich im Entenofen erneut kross zu machen. In Peking funktioniert es schließlich auch. 😉

Das ist allerdings wirklich Kritik auf hohem Niveau, denn insgesamt war das Essen sehr lecker, der Service aufmerksam und die Atmosphäre rundum angenehm. Ein wirklich toller Laden, den wir jederzeit wieder besuchen würden!

text:
Let me tell you a story.

We spent a few days in Berlin sharing, learning, and talking with brilliant people about how we can live better together. Migrants with projects, questions, and answers, people seeking to understand what kind of lives we need and want to build. There were 24 of us traveling together, tired but happy.

My friend, who was in Berlin for the first time, wanted ice cream. We didn't want to buy one from the supermarket, so we looked for an ice cream shop and walked there. The place was perfect: so many colors, incredible flavors, and a beautiful shop with truly lovely ceramic pieces.

Everything was wonderful, except for the way we were treated. I think few things are as simple and sweet as going to get ice cream with your friends, and yet that experience ended up being uncomfortable and unpleasant. Rude, cold, hostile, and arrogant treatment. I'm not saying it was racism, because we were all treated badly equally, but the question lingers.

There are people whose basic needs are met, who aren't living through a war, who have food and security, and yet they can still treat others in ways they wouldn't want to be treated themselves.

We paid 5 euros for each ice cream, which was absolutely delicious, but it was accompanied by an unnecessary bitterness and a tension that marred what could have been a simply beautiful moment.
originalText:
Te cuento una historia.

Estamos unos días en Berlín para compartir, aprender y conversar con gente brillante sobre cómo podemos vivir mejor juntos. Migrantes con proyectos, preguntas y respuestas, personas buscando entender qué vidas necesitamos y queremos construir. Éramos 24 personas viajando juntas, cansadas pero contentas.

Mi amiga, que estaba por primera vez en Berlín, quería un helado. No queríamos comprar uno del supermercado, así que buscamos una heladería y caminamos hasta allí. El lugar era perfecto: muchos colores, sabores increíbles y una tienda preciosa, con piezas de cerámica realmente hermosas.

Todo fue maravilloso, excepto por la atención humana que recibimos. Creo que pocas cosas son tan sencillas y dulces como ir a comprar un helado con tus amigos, y aun así esa experiencia terminó siendo incómoda y desagradable. Un trato rudo, frío, hostil y prepotente. No digo que fuera racismo, porque nos trató mal a todos por igual, pero la pregunta me ronda.

Hay personas que tienen sus necesidades cubiertas, que no viven una guerra, que tienen comida y seguridad, y aun así pueden llegar a tratar a los demás como no quieren que las traten a ellas.

Pagamos 5 euros por cada helado, que estaba absolutamente delicioso, acompañado de una amargura innecesaria y una tensión que llenó un momento que podía haber sido simplemente bonito.

text:
First of all, the food was truly delicious. I had reserved a table for a birthday celebration. Upon arrival, we were shown to our seats and asked if we wanted sparkling or still water. We assumed this was included in the menu, but it was charged extra at €8.

The appetizer drinks menu was presented to us first, with drinks ranging from €13 to €18, which seemed perfectly reasonable for 200ml. Upon request, we were then given the cocktail and drinks menu. It was very confusing and difficult to read.

With the second course (the duck skin), we were offered caviar, without any mention that this small tin cost an extra €40. While this is perfectly acceptable for house-made caviar, it definitely should have been mentioned beforehand.

Once we had finished all the courses and consumed plenty of drinks, we were given the bill upon request.


After a short time, a waiter came to take our payment. I paid the amount X by card and gave the waiter a €10 note as a tip. Upon this, he said to me, "We share the tips with the entire kitchen and service staff. Isn't it possible to tip more?" In my opinion, this was an absolutely unpleasant and inappropriate question, and simply unacceptable.

I replied with a simple "no," to which he responded with only an "okay" and an unfriendly, dismissive "Have a nice evening." One jacket was then brought to us, but I had to ask about the other. All in all, from that moment on, the situation became very strange and uncomfortable. We no longer felt welcome and were treated like we didn't exist. For such a "fancy" restaurant and considering the amount we spent on food and drinks, this was completely unacceptable, in my opinion.
originalText:
Zu aller erst, das Essen war wirklich sehr lecker. Ich habe eine Tisch mit den Anlass Geburtstag reserviert. Als wir an kamen wurde uns ein Platz zu gewiesen und wir wurden gefragt ob wir Wasser mit Sprudel oder still wollen, dachten das gehört zum Menü wurde aber am Ende mit 8€ Extra abgerechnet.
Die Apetizer Getränke karte wurde uns zuerst gereicht, 13-18€ ein Drink, erstmal völlig okay für 200ml. Auf extra Nachfrage wurde uns dann auch die Cocktail und Getränke Karte gegeben. Sehr unübersichtlich und anstrengend zu lesen.
Zum zweiten Gang (der Entenhaut) wurde uns Kaviar dazu angeboten, mit keiner Silbe aber erwähnt das dieses kleine döschen 40€ extra kostet. Für Kaviar aus eigener Herstellung ist das völlig in Ordnung, man hätte es aber auf jeden Fall dazu sagen müssen.
Als wir dann alle Gänge fertig hatten, auch reichlich getrunken haben wurde uns auf bitte die Rechnung gegeben.
Nach kurzer Zeit kam dann auch ein Kellner zum bezahlen, ich habe die Summe X mit Karte bezahlt und dem kellner einen 10€ Schein als Trinkgeld gereicht, auf diese Handlung sagte er zu mir, „wir teilen das Trinkgeld mit der ganzen Küche und dem Service Personal, ist mehr Trinkgeld nicht möglich“? Eine absolut unangenehme und unangebrachte Frage meiner Meinung nach und gehört sich auch nicht.
Darauf hin antwortete ich mit einem einfach „nein“ daraufhin kam nur noch ein okay und ein unfreundliches abgespeistes „schönen Abend noch“
Eine Jacke wurde uns dann gebracht, zwecks der anderen musste ich auch noch nachfragen. Alles in allem war ab diesem Moment die Situation sehr komisch und unangenehm. Man hat sich nicht mehr willkommen gefühlt und wurde wie Luft behandelt.
Bei so einem „noblen“ Restaurant und der Summe die man dort für Essen und trinken gelassen hat, war das schon ein absolutes no Go meiner Meinung nach.

placeAddress: Mr. Subs, Innstraße 26, 12043 Berlin, Germany
text:
I've been ordering from you for several years now and have almost placed 90 orders 😅. It's about time for a review.

During this time, I've tried almost every dish and have rarely been disappointed.

The pasta is always a large portion with consistently high quality.

The pizzas are generously topped and baked so the top doesn't collapse 👍. The wraps can sometimes have a bit too much oil due to the tuna, but that varies from day to day. Otherwise, the price-performance ratio is solid.

The pizza rolls or the three-cheese pizza as an appetizer are fantastic.

The potato wedges, fries, or chicken pieces, with their selection of sauces, are a great option for a light meal.

The burger with feta cheese is absolutely delicious.

I could go on, but see for yourself.

Definitely the best delivery service, as the drivers are friendly, very reliable, and fast.
originalText:
Bestelle bei euch nun schon seit mehreren Jahren und bin nun bei fast 90 Bestellungen 😅. Wird mal Zeit für eine Bewertung.

In der Zeit habe ich mich durch fast jedes Gericht probiert und war nur selten enttäuscht.
Pasta immer eine große Portion bei gleichbleibender hoher Qualität.
Pizzen sind gut belegt und gebacken, sodass die Spitze nicht einknickt 👍
Beim Wrap kann es vorkommen, dass durch den Thunfisch etwas viel Öl mit drauf ist, aber das ist Tages abhängig. Sonst auch hier solides Preis-Leistungsverhältnis.

Die Pizzabrötchen oder die Pizza mit 3 Käse als Vorspeise sind ein Traum.
Kartoffelecken, Pommes oder Hähnchenteile sind mit der Soßen Auswahl eine gute Option für den kleinen Hunger.
Burger mit Schafskäse ist sehr sehr lecker.

Ich könnte noch mehr ausführen, aber überzeugt euch selber.
Definitiv der beste Lieferdienst, da auch die Fahrer freundlich und sehr zuverlässig und schnell sind.

text:
We love coming here because the ice cream is truly delicious. The quality is consistently high, the selection of 18 flavors is varied, and visiting has become a regular part of our routine.

We especially appreciate that gluten-free cones have been available for about two months now. Unfortunately, this is still not a given for people with celiac disease, and it allows children and adults to enjoy ice cream with much less worry. We are very happy about this new offering.

However, we feel the €1.00 surcharge for the gluten-free cone is quite high. Since regular cones, cups, or paper cups are already included in the price of a scoop, the ice cream costs noticeably more for those affected. Families with children who rely on gluten-free products often don't have a real choice.

From our perspective, there is also room for improvement in preventing cross-contamination. Often, only one or two flavors contain gluten, for example, brownie or strawberry cheesecake. Nevertheless, the ice creams are served with the same scoops. Separate spoons for each flavor or clearly defined procedures could significantly reduce the risk of cross-contamination.

The placement of the waffle cones directly above the ice cream counter is also problematic for people with celiac disease, as crumbs can fall onto the flavors below.

Since the staff changes frequently, we would also appreciate clearly communicated standards for handling gluten-free orders, such as washing hands or changing gloves after handling cones containing gluten, and using a freshly cleaned or separate ice cream spoon.

Currently, when you ask for "Gluten-free, please," you get fresh, untouched ice cream from the refrigerated fridge with a freshly washed spoon, but it's always a good idea to remind the staff.

We understand that gluten-free products are more expensive and require extra care. That's precisely why we would like to see the existing offerings implemented more consistently.

If these points were improved, this ice cream parlor would be a real insider tip for people with celiac disease. We will continue to enjoy coming here and hope that the already great offerings will be made even more inclusive in the future.
originalText:
Wir kommen sehr gerne hierher, denn das Eis schmeckt wirklich hervorragend. Die Qualität ist konstant hoch, die Auswahl mit 18 Eissorten abwechslungsreich und der Besuch gehört für uns inzwischen fest dazu.

Besonders positiv finden wir, dass seit etwa zwei Monaten auch glutenfreie Waffelbecher angeboten werden. Für Menschen mit Zöliakie ist das leider noch immer keine Selbstverständlichkeit und ermöglicht Kindern und Erwachsenen ein deutlich unbeschwerteres Eis-Erlebnis. Wir freuen uns sehr über dieses neue Angebot.

Den Aufpreis von 1,00 € für den glutenfreien Waffelbecher empfinden wir jedoch als sehr hoch. Da normale Waffelhörnchen, Waffelbecher oder Pappbecher bereits im Kugelpreis enthalten sind, kostet das Eis für Betroffene spürbar mehr. Gerade Familien mit Kindern, die auf glutenfreie Produkte angewiesen sind, haben hier oft keine echte Wahlmöglichkeit.

Aus unserer Sicht gibt es außerdem noch Verbesserungspotenzial bei der Vermeidung von Kreuzkontamination. Häufig enthalten nur ein oder zwei Sorten glutenhaltige Zutaten, beispielsweise Brownie oder Strawberry Cheesecake. Dennoch werden die Eissorten mit denselben Eislöffeln portioniert. Separate Löffel für jede Sorte oder klar definierte Abläufe könnten das Risiko einer Kontamination deutlich reduzieren.

Auch die Platzierung der Waffelhörnchen direkt über der Eistheke ist für Menschen mit Zöliakie ungünstig, da Krümel auf die darunterliegenden Sorten fallen können.

Da das Team häufig wechselt, würden wir uns außerdem klar kommunizierte Standards für den Umgang mit glutenfreien Bestellungen wünschen, beispielsweise Händewaschen oder Handschuhwechsel nach dem Anfassen glutenhaltiger Waffeln sowie die Verwendung eines frisch gereinigten oder separaten Eislöffels.
Momentan bekommt man beim Schlagwort "Bitte Glutenfreie" das frische unberührte Eis aus dem Nachschub Kühlschrank mit einem frisch gewaschen Löffel, aber man sollte immer sicherheitshalber die Mitarbeiter darauf hinweisen.

Uns ist bewusst, dass glutenfreie Produkte teurer sind und zusätzliche Sorgfalt erfordern. Gerade deshalb würden wir uns wünschen, dass die bestehenden Angebote noch etwas konsequenter umgesetzt werden.

Wenn diese Punkte optimiert würden, wäre die Eisdiele aus unserer Sicht ein echter Geheimtipp für Menschen mit Zöliakie. Wir kommen weiterhin gerne her und hoffen, dass das ohnehin schon tolle Angebot in Zukunft noch etwas inklusiver gestaltet wird.

placeDescription: Laid-back cafe-restaurant in a converted dance hall with gilt-framed mirrors & freshly baked cakes.
text: Given the new management since spring 2025, I have to completely revise my review: Inside, Rix is ​​finally shining in its former glory, and the bar, which was painted a ghastly blue for a while, looks decent again. Outside, little has changed – nor was it necessary. I haven't yet tried the food menu (available from 6 pm) – otherwise, it's once again a pleasant café with very friendly service and reasonable prices. It's just a shame that it (usually) doesn't open until 4 pm.
originalText:
Angesichts des seit Frühjahr 2025 neuen Betreibers muss ich meine Bewertung vollständig erneuern:
Innen erstrahlt das Rix endlich wieder in vollem (altem) Glanz, die eine zeitlang grässlich blau gestrichene Theke sieht wieder anständig aus. Draußen hat sich wenig geändert - war auch nicht nötig. Das Speisenangebot (ab 18 Uhr) kenne ich noch nicht - ansonsten ist es wieder ein angenehmes Café mit sehr freundlicher Bedienung und passablen Preisen. Schade nur, dass es (meist) erst ab 16 Uhr öffnet.
ownerResponseText: Dear Paul, thank you so much for the update and the kind review! We hope you'll try our menu sometime 🥰🌤️🍅
ownerResponseOriginalText: Lieber Paul, vielen Dank für das Update und die nette Rezension! Wir hoffen, du probierst dich bei Gelegenheit mal durch unsere Karte 🥰🌤️🍅

text:
Rather unfriendly service, limited food selection on an already small menu ("everything's still new, only the second day..."), long waits before being served, and paying the bill took far too long.

Overall, with only 25 guests, two and a half completely overwhelmed staff members at the bar and in the dining room.
The food was under-seasoned (meatballs OK, potato salad watery, antipasti bland and without salt) – no reason to return.

A shame, I had hoped for a fresh start with the new management and concept.

The price was okay – but the quality didn't justify it.
originalText:
Eher unfreundliche Bewirtung, eingeschränkte Speisenauswahl bei eh kleiner Karte ("noch alles neu, erst zweiter Tag..."), langes Warten bis man überhaupt bedient wird, ebenso wurde zum Bezahlen zu viel Zeit benötigt.
Insgesamt bei 25 Gästen zweieinhalb völlig überforderte Kräfte an Bar und Service.
Essen ungenügend abgeschmeckt (Bouletten OK, Kartoffelsalat wässrig, Antipasti langweilig und ohne Salz) - kein Grund wiederzukommen.
Schade, hatte bei neuer Bewirtung und Konzept auf einen schönen Neustart gehofft.
Preis ok - Leistung aber auch dafür eher nicht.

placeAddress: Arkaoda, Karl-Marx-Platz 16-18, 12043 Berlin, Germany
text:
Arcaoda used to be a really great place with cool events and a good atmosphere. Unfortunately, none of that remains.

We paid €12 for entry at 2 a.m. and were completely disappointed by the terrible music. After a short time, we wanted to leave, but of course, there was no refund. Instead, we were simply told to go to the other side of the street so as not to disturb the neighbors.

This was the third time we've been disappointed. It's a real shame. For me, Arcaoda is sadly not what it used to be.
originalText:
Früher war das Arcaoda eine richtig gute Location mit coolen Events und guter Stimmung. Leider ist davon heute nichts mehr übrig.

Wir haben um 2 Uhr nachts 12 € Eintritt bezahlt und wurden von der schlechten Musik komplett enttäuscht. Nach kurzer Zeit wollten wir wieder gehen, eine Erstattung gab es natürlich nicht. Stattdessen hieß es nur, wir sollten auf die andere Straßenseite gehen, damit die Nachbarn nicht gestört werden.

Das war inzwischen schon das dritte Mal, dass wir enttäuscht wurden. Wirklich schade. Das Arcaoda ist für mich leider nicht mehr das, was es einmal war.

text:
The night was meant to be a birthday celebration and everyone arrived in a great mood, but our experience with the staff made the evening disappointing. They complained when we sang “Happy Birthday,” asked us to adjust our chairs even though we weren't blocking the way while other tables were , and told us we were too noisy despite the bar playing loud music itself.

When we arrived around 19:00 the bar was still mostly empty, and we overheard staff members saying they didn’t want to be there and seemed frustrated. Unfortunately, that frustration appeared to be directed at us as customers during the night.

Overall, the experience left a negative impression, and I would not recommend this place.

placeAddress: Arkaoda, Karl-Marx-Platz 16-18, 12043 Berlin, Germany
text:
I don’t usually write negative reviews because everyone is working hard and I don’t want to be mean. However, yesterday was my birthday and we chose this bar to celebrate because we like the vibe, and that was the worst decision ever.

The staff seem to be against happiness; they complain about EVERYTHING: because we’re taking up too many seats, because we’re making too much noise, because my friend sang “Happy Birthday” to me.

Even random people were complaining about their complaints.

In the end, they refused to serve us any more drinks because we were “talking too loudly” in a damn nightclub bar. I won’t be recommending it anymore.

Ps: The drinks are super expensive and weren’t that great, and now I don’t even know if it was on purpose or not.

text:
A true Neukölln pub with heart!

At Zum Magendoktor, you immediately feel welcome. They have a Billa supermarket, a great atmosphere, and plenty of fun – just like a proper Berlin pub should be. What's especially nice is that you always meet new people and easily strike up a conversation. Whether you're a regular or visiting for the first time, you'll feel like you're among friends in no time. Highly recommended if you're looking for an authentic pub atmosphere in Neukölln! 🍻
originalText:
Echte Neuköllner Kneipe mit Herz!
Im Zum Magendoktor fühlt man sich sofort willkommen. Hier gibt’s Billa, gute Stimmung und jede Menge Spaß – genau so, wie eine richtige Berliner Kneipe sein soll. Besonders schön ist, dass man immer neue Leute kennenlernt und einfach locker ins Gespräch kommt. Ob Stammgast oder zum ersten Mal da – nach kurzer Zeit fühlt man sich wie unter Freunden. Absolut empfehlenswert, wenn man Lust auf ehrliche Kneipenatmosphäre in Neukölln hat! 🍻

text:
Experience:

After patiently waiting for half an hour, and just as the friendly employee was beginning to prepare my order, someone (apparently the owner or manager) intervened in an extremely rude manner. He interrupted the process and gave my place in line to acquaintances of his who were standing behind me, brazenly claiming it wasn't my turn.

Negative Points:

Lack of professionalism: Prioritizing "acquaintances and friends" over waiting customers is the worst business practice imaginable. Tone and manner: The way I was spoken to in front of my family lacked any basic courtesy or customer service. Chaotic management: The employee was simply trying to do his job, but the "boss" himself ruined the experience with his poor behavior.

Conclusion:

My family and I left the restaurant immediately and will never return. A business isn't defined solely by its product, but also by "decency and conduct" – unfortunately, the standard here was utterly disappointing. I cannot recommend this place to anyone who values ​​respect, appreciation, and following order.

Er unterbrach den Vorgang und gab meinen Platz in der Schlange Bekannten von ihm, die hinter mir standen, mit der dreisten Behauptung, ich sei nicht an der Reihe.

​Negative Punkte:

​Mangel an Professionalität: Die Bevorzugung von "Bekannten und Freunden" gegenüber wartenden Kunden ist das schlechteste geschäftliche Verhalten, das man sich vorstellen kann. ​Tonfall und Umgang: Die Art und Weise, wie in Gegenwart meiner Familie mit mir gesprochen wurde, entbehrte jeglicher Grundregeln der Höflichkeit und des Kundenservice. ​Chaotisches Management: Der Mitarbeiter versuchte lediglich, seinen Job zu machen, aber der "Chef" selbst ruinierte das Erlebnis durch sein schlechtes Benehmen.

​Fazit:

Meine Familie und ich haben das Lokal sofort verlassen und werden nie wiederkommen. text:
The food here is good. Decent variety on the menu.
This review is about the awful bar woman.
Tonight while at the bar with a colleague, we ate, drank, moved between inside and out, and eventually decided to go inside, pay and then leave.
The service throughout the evening from the main bar lady was borderline hostile. I’m not sure what made her so miserable, but her attitude to myself and my female colleague was awful.

At the end of the evening, As I walked through the quite busy bar and approached the end of the bar to pay our bill, she starts screaming something in German about us not paying.

I decided at that moment not to tip. I’ve never been as embarrassed in my life. If she truly felt we weren’t going to pay, she should have watched me at the bar and then made a move, that would have been reasonable and acceptable. What is not acceptable is shouting loudly about someone not paying while they are actually approaching the bar to pay.

text: 25 minute wait for one course. Took one bite of a burger and found it was burnt on the bottom and totally dry. Was offered for it be be redone but having waited so long for it in the first place  didn’t want to make everyone wait for me once they had finished. The waiter as also a bit cheeky when I mentioned the wait. ‘What do you want - fast food?’  Two people had prawn dishes on a bed of lettuce. Once they had eaten the prawns they could see the lettuce was sitting in a load of water. Not a good experience.
ownerResponseText:
Dear Guest,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your visit did not meet your expectations.

We sincerely apologize that your burger was not prepared to the standard we expect. As soon as you brought this to our attention, we immediately offered to prepare a fresh burger. When you decided not to wait for a replacement, we of course removed the burger from your bill without hesitation.

Regarding the waiting time, we understand that waiting can be frustrating. However, in a busy full-service restaurant, a preparation time of around 25 minutes is generally considered reasonable, as all of our dishes are freshly prepared to order. We regret that this affected your overall experience.

We are also sorry if our team member's comment came across as inappropriate. Friendly and respectful service is something we take very seriously, and we will address this with our team.

With regard to the prawn dishes, the lettuce is intentionally served with a clear papaya dressing, which naturally collects at the bottom of the bowl. We appreciate that this may have looked like water, but it is in fact part of the dish.

Thank you again for your honest feedback. It helps us to improve, and we hope you will give us another opportunity to provide you with the quality of food and service we strive to deliver.

text:
My visit to this McDonald's was a complete disappointment. The only positive thing: the staff were friendly and tried their best. Unfortunately, that's where the positives end.

The food wasn't inedible, but it was simply prepared without any care and tasted bland. It was soggy, unappealing, and far from what one would expect, even from a fast-food chain. Having to endure long lines for this is simply frustrating. There isn't even a screen for ordering.

However, what really made the experience unpleasant was the situation at the tables. Homeless drug addicts were constantly wandering through the restaurant, pointing directly at customers' food and actively begging – while people were eating. This is extremely unpleasant and intrusive. They also openly helped themselves to leftover food from the counters and muttered incoherently to themselves.

With all due respect, as a paying customer, I expect to be able to enjoy my meal in peace and without being bothered. The fact that no security personnel intervene or are even present is completely incomprehensible. A minimum level of order and control should be a given, even in a fast-food restaurant.
originalText:
Mein Besuch in diesem McDonald’s war insgesamt enttäuschend. Das einzig Positve: Die Mitarbeiter waren freundlich und bemüht. Leider hört es da schon auf.

Das Essen war nicht ungenießbar, aber schlicht lieblos zubereitet und geschmacklich schwach. Labrig, wenig ansprechend und weit entfernt von dem, was man selbst von einer Fast-Food-Kette zumindest erwarten darf. Dafür dann auch noch lange Schlangen in Kauf nehmen zu müssen, ist schlicht frustrierend. Es gibt nichtmal einen Bildschirm zum Bestellen.

Was den Aufenthalt jedoch wirklich unangenehm gemacht hat, war die Situation an den Tischen. Obdachlose Junkies liefen permanent durch den Laden, deuteten direkt auf das Essen der Gäste und bettelten aktiv – während die Menschen gerade am Essen waren. Das ist extrem unangenehm und übergriffig. Zusätzlich bedienten sie sich offen an Essensresten von den Ablagen und sprachen wirres Zeug mit sich selbst.

Bei allem menschlichen Verständnis: Als zahlender Kunde erwarte ich, mein Essen in Ruhe und ohne Belästigung genießen zu können. Dass hier keinerlei Sicherheitspersonal eingreift oder überhaupt präsent ist, ist absolut unverständlich. Ein Mindestmaß an Ordnung und Kontrolle sollte selbst in einem Fast-Food-Restaurant selbstverständlich sein.
